prompt.alinti: These Claude Skills will turn Claude Code into an NNN Architect. This is a GitHub repo which will give Claude Code the necessary skill set to build out flawless, specialized NNN workflows by using 14 different Claude Skills. The repo is called NNN Skills, and it has over 6,000 stars on GitHub. And it's meant to solve a bunch of the common problems that arise from using Claude Code to build out NNN workflows. And that may include CloudCode using the wrong MCP tools or just using them incorrectly. It may also get stuck in validation error loops. It may get confused on which workflow patterns it should use. And it also may misconfigure different types of nodes and their dependencies. But with the 14 skills within this GitHub repo, you are really turning CloudCode into an NNN specialist, in which it will understand the correct NNN syntax, how to use NNN's MCP tools effectively, and it will be able to reference proven workflow patterns for real-world usage.

So if you're building automations with NNN and you're using Claude Code to do it, then this repo is a must-have in your tech stack. Now, if you want to learn more about Claude Code, then make sure to comment Claude below in the comments, and I'll send you my free Claude Code masterclass.
